news.headline: Palo Alto Soars 7%, Okta Up 11% as DHS Chief Warns of “A Severe Cyber Threat”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysPalo Alto Networks jumped 7% today as Okta, Zscaler, Cloudflare and other cybersecurity stocks rallied on a warning from the Homeland Security secretary of “a severe cyber threat. ”The same official said he’s “98% confident” recent outages weren’t foreign attacks, so investors bought the warning before any new demand showed up.

news.headline: Datadog Fell 12% on a Flat Fourth-Quarter Outlook. Analysts Raised Its 2027 Earnings Estimate 6%
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog fell more than 12% on Nov. 4 on a flat fourth-quarter guide, as its largest customer, an AI company, cuts its usage to its contract minimum.

news.headline: Temporal Cloud Enters Public Preview on Microsoft Azure
news.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, November 18, 2026--Temporal, an open-source platform that powers the world's most capable AI applications, today announced at Microsoft Ignite that Temporal Cloud is available as a public preview on Microsoft Marketplace. Access to the Azure preview is limited and will be granted on a rolling basis.
